description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for Azure Table based reminder storage in Orleans. It includes the AzureTableReminderStorageOptions class that specifies the table name, and a validator class for validating these options.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring Azure Table based reminder storage, including the table name.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AzureTableReminderStorageOptions, used to validate configuration options.

methods.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptions
methods.description: Constructor for AzureTableReminderStorageOptions, sets default table name.

methods.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor for the validator class, initializes validation for the options.
